title: Pie chart
description:
A pie chart shows each row's share: `label_column` names the slices, `value_column`
sizes them (positive values only). The default renderer is one proportional bar with a
legend; `chart { renderer: circle }` draws a round pie. See `:help dbdash-charts`.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: bar (default): series:nth-child(N) colors
show.description:
One bar split in proportion, the legend under it with the value and the percentage.
`series:nth-child(N) { color }` colors the slices in order.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: chart { renderer: circle, palette: tableau }
show.description:
A round pie on a braille canvas, the legend beside it (`legend { position: bottom }`
puts it under); `palette: tableau` instead of the colorscheme's colors.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: chart { hole }, format
show.description:
`chart { hole: 0.6 }` leaves a hole of 60% of the radius (a doughnut, Chart.js
`cutout`) and writes the total in it; `format` is the Python format of the values
("{:,} k").

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: chart { angle: 180 }, legend { position: bottom }
show.description:
`chart { angle: 180 }` draws the upper half (Chart.js `circumference: 180`, a
gauge-like pie); `legend { position: bottom }` puts the legend under it.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: sort, top, other_label
show.description:
`sort: desc` orders the slices by size, `top: 3` keeps the three largest and puts the
rest in one slice named by `other_label` (default "Other"; styled as `series.other`).

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: series.<name> colors, legend parts
show.description:
`series.<name> { color }` colors slices by name; `label`, `value` and `percent {
display: none }` leave a column out of the legend.
